snippet.title: Spore Hero and Hero Arena Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Presenting the latest from Maxis  Spore Hero and Spore Hero Arena. Create and customize your Spore Hero in fully functional 3D Creature Creators specifically designed for the Wii and NDS. Take your hero on an epic adventure as you battle your enemies with the fate of your planet hanging in the balance.

Spore Hero (Wii) and Spore Hero Arena (NDS)  Coming Soon
www.spore.com
